AlternateTargets: a wall sheer for ten thousand fathoms
Senses.Explanation: A wall so high and sheer that it gives no route over or through it. Chan records use that impossible-to-pass barrier as a stance, a predicate, and a place where a response is demanded. In Dahui Zonggao's section of the Complete Book of the Five Lamps, an unnamed monk asks why Dahui is always like such a wall; Dahui tells the monk to say a word at that very place. Yuanwu Keqin joins the wall to blocking off the ten directions, and elsewhere predicates the wall of every person without the slightest alteration or deficiency. The records also police the image: Yuanwu says people mistakenly identify silent blankness with the sheer wall, and Zhenjing Kewen says Dongshan is not to be found there. The expression occurs 470 times in 166 allowlisted texts. It therefore names an impassable encounter-setting, not mere silence and not a synonym for any named teacher.
Senses.Note: One figurative object across predicative and locative constructions. The different assessments are text-drawn deployments of the same sheer-wall image, not separate referents or interpretive senses.
SearchAliases: a sheer wall with no way through

Occurrences.Kwic: 和尚為甚麼一向壁立萬仞？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)): in Dahui Zonggao's governed section, an unnamed monk asks why Dahui is always standing like an unscalable sheer wall. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not supply the monk's personal name.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰：你試向壁立萬仞處道一句看。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)): answering the unnamed monk in his governed section, Dahui Zonggao tells him to try saying one word at the place of the unscalable sheer wall.

Occurrences.Kwic: 壁立萬仞坐斷十方。可以入大解脫門傳正法眼藏。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo's Sayings Record (圓悟佛果禪師語錄), Yuanwu Keqin's teaching-seat prose couples the wall with cutting off the ten directions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 人人分上，各各壁立萬仞，無一絲毫移易虧欠。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Collected Instructions of the Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄), Yuanwu Keqin predicates the wall of each person without alteration or deficiency.

Occurrences.Kwic: 時流錯認，遂向泯默，以為無縫罅、無摸索，壁立萬仞。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Chan Master Foguo Keqin's Essentials of Mind (佛果克勤禪師心要), Yuanwu Keqin explicitly reports the mistaken equation of silent blankness with the wall.

Occurrences.Kwic: 擬欲向壁立萬仞處見洞山，洞山且不在壁立萬仞處；
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Continued Essentials of Sayings from Ancient Worthies (續古尊宿語要), Zhenjing Kewen denies that he is found at the ten-thousand-fathom wall within his Dongshan address.

Occurrences.Kwic: 壁立萬仞處淨裸裸。平田淺草裏峭危危。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo's Sayings Record (圓悟佛果禪師語錄), Yuanwu Keqin contrasts the bare clarity at the ten-thousand-fathom wall with danger in the level field and shallow grass.
